notes.title: Devlog 1
notes.content: [p]Hi guys, thank you all for the continued support and feedback![/p][p]We just wanted to do a mini update on a small part of everything we’ve been working on. Development’s been going really well, and while we’re gearing up to share some BIG news later, here’s a little sneak peek:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Improved rain effects:[/b][/p][p]We’ve been working on a few visual improvements including the rain effects. We feel the new rain is a lot softer and has a better feel compared to the old one.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920761/3466f35dedb7e4ed94cb5105765c2df1ee174d5f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New attack animation:[/b][/p][p]We’ve received a lot of feedback on how the combat feels, so we’ve made some major overhauls to the combat system along with some visual improvements.[/p][p]On this track, we’ve been busy refining the systems and updating the visuals such as the attack animations to better match the faster pace and intensity of the game. Combat should now feel much more fluid and satisfying in the upcoming versions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920761/17c00bab10e125712a69f0beaf76679f08dc5a23.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Combat combos:[/b][/p][p]We’ve also been exploring some new combo mechanics that offer new ways to fight and makes the combat feel more dynamic, fluid, and personal. Here’s a sneak peek at one of the many new moves we’ve been working on.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920761/12700f4f1a129fa696839aaeccb92908c5a0029e.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]New Capsule Art:[/b][/p][p]Some of you may have noticed that we gave our store page a fresh look with a new capsule art. We  felt like the old design didn’t feel quite right and wasn’t telling the story of our game, so we went back and made something that fits the game’s vibe better. We’re happy with it, but we’d love to know what you think![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920761/4a1dc50d591ca49a7e66a9351fd811e2e8ed9cd1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve got more features and surprises in the works, so stay tuned for those updates.[/p][p]In the meantime, we share little updates, clips, and experiments over on [url="https://x.com/sojourn_past"]X[/url], so feel free to follow along there too! For feedback and more news, come hang out with us on [url="https://discord.gg/Y43CgCvX59"]discord[/url]![/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p align="start"]ReDimension Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Public Demo is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Our Public Demo is Live! [/h1]

Hey everyone! 😊

We’re beyond excited(and a little nervous too) to announce that our very own public demo is finally LIVE on steam! Lots of hard work and plenty of late nights have been put towards it and we’re really eager for you guys to try it out and give us feedback!

[h2][b]What’s in the demo?[/b][/h2]

The demo will give you a taste of what we’ve been working on. It's about an hour of gameplay where you’ll get to experience some of the world and challenges of Sojourn Past(and also see a bit of the story). It’s just a preview, but we hope it gives you a glimpse of the world we’re building, and we can’t wait for you to check it out.

[h3][b]A Few Quick Notes:[/b][/h3]

[b]Bug reports: [/b]Since the game is still in development, you might run into bugs! If We’d love it if you could report them over on our discord. Link -> [url=https://discord.gg/fxYMhZWP2h]https://discord.gg/fxYMhZWP2h. [/url]

[b]Feedback: [/b]If you have any feedback we would love to hear it!-> [url=https://forms.gle/ShrpCSj3YURAavSp9]https://forms.gle/ShrpCSj3YURAavSp9[/url]

[b]Steam Deck Support:[/b] Although not verified for Steam Deck, Sojourn Past should work okay on the Steam Deck. Let us know if you face any problems.

And hey, if you’re sharing your experience on Twitter/X, we’d be so happy if you tagged us @Sojourn_Past or used the hashtag #SojournPast. We’d love to see your screenshots or hear all about your adventure with the demo. 💙

That’s it for now! We hope you have a great time playing the demo!

Best,
ReDimension Team
